comment: Cue names to files, for `sound` beats and per-stage music. Adding a track is an edit here, not a code change. Roles: bed = plays under a whole stage, cue = short musical sting, seam = plays between stages (build-up, hand-off, curtain), sfx = one-off effect. `skill` names the show skill a cue accompanies. Ids ending -1/-2/-3 are alternate takes of the same prompt; `take` groups them. `hidden` keeps a sound in the manifest and on disk but out of the app and out of the agent's catalogue — for a track being replaced rather than deleted. Delete the flag to bring it back.

night-hush.description: Celesta notes struck far apart, low bowed strings sustaining, one high harmonic held above, deep quiet between. Cool and dark blue. Fades away at the end despite being asked not to, so it wants `fade` rather than `loop`.

forest-air-1.description: Guitar harmonics, breathy flute, bowed cimbalom, sparse celesta. Woodland and unhurried, no melody to follow. The steadiest of the batch — it ends near the level it starts at, so it is the one that loops without a hole.

forest-air-2.description: Guitar harmonics, breathy flute, bowed cimbalom, sparse celesta. Woodland and unhurried, no melody to follow. Fades to silence at the end despite being asked not to, so it wants `fade` or a hand-off rather than `loop`.

meadow-open-1.description: Sustained strings, clarinet long tones, brushed autoharp, warm pad. Open country in warm light. Came back short of the length asked for and fades at the end, so it wants `fade` rather than `loop`.

meadow-open-2.description: Sustained strings, clarinet long tones, brushed autoharp, warm pad. The quietest and sparsest of the three meadow takes. Fades at the end, so it wants `fade` rather than `loop`.

meadow-open-3.description: Sustained strings, clarinet long tones, brushed autoharp, warm pad. The fullest of the three meadow takes. Fades at the end, so it wants `fade` rather than `loop`.

village-lane-1.description: Sparse plucked mandolin, soft accordion pad, clarinet long tones, warm upright bass drone. A small street on an ordinary morning. Opens louder than the other two takes and fades to silence at the end, so it wants `fade` rather than `loop`.

danger-close-1.description: Low double bass drone, muted cimbalom tremolo, soft timpani rumble, sustained low brass. The most eventful of the three: its level swings about 20 dB across the piece, so things happen in it rather than under it. Fades at the end, so it wants `fade` rather than `loop`.

danger-close-2.description: Low double bass drone, muted cimbalom tremolo, soft timpani rumble, sustained low brass. The steadiest of the three and the one that behaves most like a bed, but also the loudest. Fades at the end, so it wants `fade` rather than `loop`.

danger-close-3.description: Low double bass drone, muted cimbalom tremolo, soft timpani rumble, sustained low brass. The only one that came back at the full length asked for, and the quietest through the middle. Fades to silence at the end, so it wants `fade` rather than `loop`.

skeleton-steps.description: Strings struck with the wood of the bow — sharp dry taps with silence between them. Bones walking, a clock in an empty house, something approaching one step at a time. Its average level is the lowest of any bed by ten decibels, but that is the silence between the taps: the taps themselves peak as loud as anything here, so it does not want turning up. One of the few beds that does not fade at the end.

hurdy-drone-1.description: A solo hurdy-gurdy droning open fifths over a slow rotary groove. Older and stranger than anything else here — for a village fair, a road, a tale told before the others were written. Fades at the end, so it wants `fade` rather than `loop`.

hurdy-drone-2.description: A solo hurdy-gurdy droning open fifths over a slow rotary groove. Starts very quietly and grows, so it opens a scene better than it joins one. Fades at the end.

hurdy-drone-3.description: A solo hurdy-gurdy droning open fifths over a slow rotary groove. The shortest and steadiest of the three, and the one that came in already at level.

chase-comic-1.description: Scurrying pizzicato strings, bustling xylophone, chattering woodwinds and a light snare gallop. A chase played for laughs, where `race-driving` is played straight. The fuller of the two takes.

chase-comic-2.description: Scurrying pizzicato strings, bustling xylophone, chattering woodwinds and a light snare gallop. A chase played for laughs. Two dB quieter than `chase-comic-1` and the easier of the two to talk over.

race-driving-1.description: Racing staccato strings, pulsing low brass, urgent snare and driving percussion. For a chase or a race, and short enough to come round often. Ends about where it started, so unlike almost everything else here it genuinely loops.

race-driving-2.description: Racing staccato strings, pulsing low brass, urgent snare and driving percussion. Louder and fuller than `race-driving-1`, but it fades to silence at the end, so it wants `fade` rather than `loop`.

spit.description: A short wet spit, broadband and bright — the only recorded effect with as much above 4 kHz as below it.

swoosh-small.description: A small breathed swoosh with a long thin decay, no weight underneath. Much smaller and quieter than `whoosh` — for something little moving, not something big.

clock-time-1.description: Steady woodblock ticks under a sparse celesta chime. Time passing, or a wait about to end.

clock-time-2.description: Steady woodblock ticks under a sparse celesta chime. Time passing, or a wait about to end.

fly-soar-1.description: A rising string swell, a harp arpeggio upward and a light flute. Taking off, or the moment a thing turns out to be possible.

fly-soar-2.description: A rising string swell, a harp arpeggio upward and a light flute. Taking off.

gulp-eat-1.description: A descending bassoon slide and one woodblock knock. Something swallowed whole.

gulp-eat-2.description: A descending bassoon slide and one woodblock knock. Something swallowed whole.

kiss-sweet.description: A single harp glissando upward, a soft celesta note and a warm string sigh. Affection, and short enough not to labour it.

splash-1.description: A descending harp glissando, a low woodblock plop and a bubbling marimba roll. Into the water, played rather than recorded.

splash-2.description: A descending harp glissando, a low woodblock plop and a bubbling marimba roll. Into the water.

splash-3.description: A descending harp glissando, a low woodblock plop and a bubbling marimba roll. Into the water.

treasure-sparkle-1.description: An ascending glockenspiel run, a harp shimmer and a soft cymbal bloom. Gold, a reveal, a chest opening. The longest of the three takes at five seconds, so it ducks the bed while it rings.

treasure-sparkle-2.description: An ascending glockenspiel run, a harp shimmer and a soft cymbal bloom. Gold, a reveal, a chest opening.

treasure-sparkle-3.description: An ascending glockenspiel run, a harp shimmer and a soft cymbal bloom. Gold, a reveal, a chest opening.

explosion-comic-1.description: A cartoon explosion: brass stabs, slapstick percussion, a wobbling bassoon and crash cymbals. Turned down 4 dB on the way in — it arrived at -16 LUFS, the loud end of the library, and dense enough to swamp a line. Long enough to duck the bed while it runs.

explosion-comic-2.description: A cartoon explosion: brass stabs, slapstick percussion, a wobbling bassoon and crash cymbals. Turned down 4 dB on the way in, and the quietest of the three takes.

explosion-comic-3.description: A cartoon explosion: brass stabs, slapstick percussion, a wobbling bassoon and crash cymbals. Turned down 4 dB on the way in.

potion-bubble-1.description: A small glass bottle bubbling, fine wet pops. A cauldron, a potion, something brewing.

potion-bubble-2.description: A small glass bottle bubbling, fine wet pops. The shortest of the three takes, for a single bloop rather than a brew.

potion-bubble-3.description: A small glass bottle bubbling, fine wet pops.

hinge-creak-1.description: A wooden hinge creaking over a soft swell of air. Airier and more spacious than `door-creak`, which is the drier, closer take on the same idea.

hinge-creak-2.description: A wooden hinge creaking over a soft swell of air. The louder of the two takes by about 4 dB.

vanish-poof-1.description: A single puff of air with a miniature chime tail. Something disappearing. Pairs with `magic-transformation` for the other direction.

vanish-poof-2.description: A single puff of air with a miniature chime tail. Something disappearing.

vanish-poof-3.description: A single puff of air with a miniature chime tail. The gentlest of the first three takes.

vanish-poof-4.description: A single puff of air with a chime tail, from a differently worded prompt than the other three. Very quiet — about 14 dB under its siblings and the faintest sound in the library, so it will disappear under a bed unless the moment is already still.

wind-gust-1.description: One soft gust through paper leaves, rising and falling once. Weather for an outdoor scene, not a storm.

wind-gust-2.description: One soft gust through paper leaves, rising and falling once. A fuller take than `wind-gust-1`.

wind-gust-3.description: One soft gust through paper leaves. The faintest of the three by about 6 dB — the one to use under dialogue.

thunder-soft-1.description: Distant thunder with a paper edge to it, made by shaking a sheet of card. More weather than threat.

thunder-soft-2.description: Distant thunder with a paper edge to it, made by shaking a sheet of card. More weather than threat.

thunder-soft-3.description: Distant thunder with a paper edge to it, made by shaking a sheet of card. More weather than threat.

animal-call-1.description: One short animal call, small and friendly, performed by a puppeteer rather than recorded outdoors.

animal-call-2.description: One short animal call, small and friendly, performed by a puppeteer rather than recorded outdoors.

animal-call-3.description: One short animal call, small and friendly, performed by a puppeteer rather than recorded outdoors.

snore-comic-1.description: One soft comic snore: a breath in and a whistle out. Pairs with the `sleep` skill.

snore-comic-2.description: One soft comic snore: a breath in and a whistle out. Pairs with the `sleep` skill.

crowd-murmur.description: A small audience murmuring between scenes — twenty people, no words. Fills the gap `applause` and `gasp` leave. The loudest of the effects, so it will duck the bed while it runs.

sword-draw-1.description: A small wooden sword drawn from a belt: one light scrape and a tiny ring. Playful rather than dangerous.

sword-draw-2.description: A small wooden sword drawn from a belt: one light scrape and a tiny ring. The quieter of the two takes.

sword-clash-1.description: Two wooden swords knocking together twice: light hollow clacks. A puppet fight, not a battle.

sword-clash-2.description: Two wooden swords knocking together twice: light hollow clacks. A puppet fight, not a battle.

sword-clash-3.description: Two wooden swords knocking together twice: light hollow clacks. A puppet fight, not a battle.

knock-dull.description: A single short knock: fast attack, dead by a third of a second, mid-weighted with almost no top. Duller and much shorter than `thud`. Came in clipping and 6 dB hotter than the rest of the library, so it is the one sound here that was turned down on the way in.

laugh-cute.description: Short bright giggle, close mic, dry interior. Pairs with the `laugh` skill.

curtain-open-1.description: Heavy velvet curtain sweeping open across a wooden stage, with soft fabric folds, rail movement, rope and pulley detail.

curtain-open-2.description: Heavy velvet curtain sweeping open across a wooden stage, with soft fabric folds, rail movement, rope and pulley detail.

curtain-open-3.description: Heavy velvet curtain sweeping open across a wooden stage, with soft fabric folds, rail movement, rope and pulley detail.

prop-clatter-1.description: A small wooden theatre prop falls onto floorboards, clatters briefly and makes one gentle bounce.

prop-clatter-2.description: A small wooden theatre prop falls onto floorboards, clatters briefly and makes one gentle bounce.

prop-clatter-3.description: A small wooden theatre prop falls onto floorboards, clatters briefly and makes one gentle bounce.

magic-transformation-1.description: Delicate bell shimmer, reversed paper rustle and a tiny wooden-chime flourish for a handmade fairy-tale transformation.

magic-transformation-2.description: Delicate bell shimmer, reversed paper rustle and a tiny wooden-chime flourish for a handmade fairy-tale transformation.

magic-transformation-3.description: Delicate bell shimmer, reversed paper rustle and a tiny wooden-chime flourish for a handmade fairy-tale transformation.

paper-shuffle-1.description: A paper cut-out puppet shuffles across a miniature stage with dry paper rubbing and tiny cardboard taps.

paper-shuffle-2.description: A paper cut-out puppet shuffles across a miniature stage with dry paper rubbing and tiny cardboard taps.

paper-shuffle-3.description: A paper cut-out puppet shuffles across a miniature stage with dry paper rubbing and tiny cardboard taps.
